REPLACE VIEW REC_STAGE.VstgBATCHCargaUbicEstandarizada AS  LOCK ROW FOR ACCESS  SELECT   CAST( NULL AS INTEGER ) AS Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original  ,CAST( NULL AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS Texto_Ubicacion_Original  ,CAST( NULL AS INTEGER ) AS Cod_DW_Tipo_Ubicacion  ,CAST( NULL AS INTEGER ) AS Cod_DW_Fuente  ,CAST( NULL AS INTEGER ) AS Lote  ,CAST( NULL AS INTEGER ) AS Id_Buro_Suscriptor  ,cis.Id_Buro_Persona  ,CAST( NULL AS INTEGER) AS Cod_DW_Cta  ,CAST( NULL AS CHAR(32)) AS Cod_DW_Hash  ,CAST( NULL AS INTEGER)  AS Cod_DW_Ubic  ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20)) valor  ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20)) Texto_Ciudad  ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20)) Codigo_Ciudad_Dane  ,CURRENT_DATE Fecha_Reporte  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) Cod_DW_Ubicacion_Original  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) Cod_DW_Tipo_Ubicacion_Dir  ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20)) Usuario_BD  ,CURRENT_DATE Fecha_Desde  ,CURRENT_DATE Fecha_Hasta  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) Id_Flag_Nuevo  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) Id_Flag_Desde  ,cis.Cod_PIN_Persona  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS Cod_DW_Pais  ,cis.TIPO_ID  ,cis.NUMERO_ID  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Geografica' THEN CIS.TEXTO_UBICACION_ORIGINAL  END) AS DIRECCION  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Telefono' THEN CIS.TEXTO_UBICACION_ORIGINAL  END) AS TELEFONO  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Celular' THEN CIS.TEXTO_UBICACION_ORIGINAL  END) AS Celular  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Mail' THEN CIS.TEXTO_UBICACION_ORIGINAL  END) AS EMAIL  ,MAX(DFE.DIR_TIPO_DIRE) AS TIPO_DIR_STD  ,MAX(DFE.TEXTO_CIUDAD) AS CIUDAD_DIR_INSUMO_STD  ,MAX(CAST((COALESCE(DFE.DIRE_GEO,'')||' '||COALESCE(DFE.DIRE_COMPLEMENTO,'')) AS VARCHAR(100))) AS DIR_INSUMO_STD  ,MAX(TFE.TEXTO_CIUDAD) AS CIUDAD_TEL_INSUMO_STD  ,MAX(TFE.Componente_Tel)  AS  TEL_INSUMO_STD  ,MAX(TME.UBICACION_Stand)  AS  CEL_INSUMO_STD  ,MAX(EME.UBICACION_Stand2)  AS  EMAIL_INSUMO_STD  ,CAST(1 AS INTEGER) AS SEVERIDAD  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Geografica' THEN CIS.Texto_Ciudad END) CIUDAD_DIRECCION  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Telefono' THEN CIS.Texto_Ciudad END) AS CIUDAD_TELEFONO  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Geografica' THEN VGEC.Descripcion_Departamento END) AS DEPARTAMENTO_DIRECCION  ,MAX(CASE WHEN DESCRIPCION_TIPO_UBICACION='Telefono' THEN VGET.Descripcion_Departamento END) AS DEPARTAMENTO_TELEFONO  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS POR_SIM_DIR  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS ORDEN_PRIORIDAD_DIR  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS POR_SIM_TEL  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS ORDEN_PRIORIDAD_TEL  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS POR_SIM_CEL  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS ORDEN_PRIORIDAD_CEL  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS POR_SIM_MAIL  ,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS ORDEN_PRIORIDAD_MAIL  FROM REC_STAGE.BATCH_tmp_CARGA_INSUMO_STANDARD CIS  LEFT JOIN  REC_VISTA.V_Tipo_Ubicacion vtu   ON vtu.Cod_DW_Tipo_Ubicacion=cis.Cod_dw_Tipo_Ubicacion  LEFT JOIN REC_STAGE.BATCH_DireccionFisica_Estandarizada DFE   ON CIS.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original=DFE.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original  LEFT JOIN REC_VISTA.VU_Geografia VGEC   ON DFE.Codigo_Ciudad_Dane EQ VGEC.Cod_Dane_Ciudad  LEFT JOIN REC_STAGE.BATCH_TelefonoFijoEstandarizado TFE   ON CIS.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original=TFE.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original  LEFT JOIN REC_VISTA.VU_Geografia VGET   ON TFE.Codigo_Ciudad_Dane EQ VGET.Cod_Dane_Ciudad  LEFT JOIN REC_STAGE.BATCH_TelefonoMovil_Estandarizado TME   ON CIS.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original=TME.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original  LEFT JOIN REC_STAGE.BATCH_Emails_Estandarizados EME   ON CIS.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original=EME.Cod_DW_Reporte_Ubic_Original  GROUP BY 7,22,24,25  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cis.Id_Buro_Persona  ORDER BY cis.Id_Buro_Persona) EQ 1 ;
